app.name: routelab
app.errorBody: Try again. If it keeps happening, share the request ID with the team.
app.notFoundBody: The page you opened doesn't exist or was moved.

auth.title: Sign in to routelab
auth.subtitle: Design, test and load-test your APIs.
auth.noProviders: No sign-in options are set up yet.

errors.providerUnavailable: That sign-in option isn't available. Pick another one.
errors.stateMismatch: The sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Try again.
errors.denied: Sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
errors.profileInvalid: The provider didn't share your name and email. Allow access, then try again.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your account has no verified email. Verify it with the provider, then try again.
errors.sessionInvalid: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

desktopOnly.title: Desktop only
desktopOnly.body: routelab needs a screen at least 1280px wide. Widen the window or switch to a desktop.

collections.title: Collections
collections.emptyBody: Import an OpenAPI doc to see its endpoints here.

actions.label: Actions for {{name}}
actions.deleteBlocked: Can't delete while a test runs

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body_one: Its {{count}} endpoint leaves the sidebar. Past runs stay in History.
delete.body_other: Its {{count}} endpoints leave the sidebar. Past runs stay in History.

stressTests.title: Stress tests

modeHints.single: One endpoint at full target RPS

noEndpoint.label: No endpoint selected

import.title: Import an OpenAPI doc to start
import.body: Its endpoints show up in the sidebar. Pick one to set up a load test.

pick.title: Pick an endpoint from the sidebar
pick.body: You'll edit the request here, set the load above, then start the test and watch live results.

noEndpoint.orNew: Or test any URL with a new request.

scratch.label: Scratch request
scratch.note: Not saved to a collection. Kept until this tab closes.

notFound.title: This endpoint isn't in your collections
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or the link is from another account. Pick an endpoint from the sidebar.

stressTests.resultsLater: Live results appear here once the test starts.
stressTests.finishedNoData: Per-second data for this run is no longer available. Core keeps it for an hour after a run.
stressTests.failedNoData: The run failed before it sent any per-second data.

recent.title: Recent runs
recent.empty: No runs yet. Your finished tests will show up here.

empty.title: No test runs yet
empty.body: Runs you start show up here with their results.

noMatch.title: No runs match
noMatch.bodyMore: Try another search or status, or load more runs.

pick.title: Pick a run
pick.body: Choose a run on the left to see its results.

notFound.title: This run isn't available
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or the link is from another account.

percentiles.title: Percentiles
percentiles.vsPrevious: this run (top) vs the previous run of this route
percentiles.noPrevious: no earlier run of this route to compare

routeRuns.title: Runs of this route
routeRuns.note: History keeps the final summary of each run. Per-second charts are on the Stress tests page while a run is live and for an hour after it ends.

bodyEditor.label: Request body
bodyEditor.empty: No body. Type JSON or insert a placeholder.

issues.unquotedText: Line {{line}}: {{token}} is replaced with text. Put it inside quotes.
issues.unknownGenerator: Line {{line}}: {{token}} isn't a placeholder. Use one of {{known}}.

testConfig.capacityExceeded: Another test is running, try again shortly.

issues.rampLongerThanDuration: Can't be longer than the duration ({{max}}s).

blocked.noTarget: Pick an endpoint from the sidebar first.
blocked.pathParam: Fill in {{param}} in the URL to start.
blocked.maskedSecret: Re-enter {{name}} to start. Past runs hide secret values.
blocked.invalidBody: Fix the request body to start.
blocked.invalidConfig: Fix the test settings to start.
blocked.noServer: Set a base URL for this collection to start.
blocked.noUrl: Enter a full URL that starts with http:// or https://.

sendRequest.title: Response

idle.title: No response yet
idle.body: Send the request once to check it before a load test. You'll see its status, headers and body here. Nothing is saved.

sendRequest.binary: Binary response ({{size}}). Its body isn't shown.
sendRequest.truncated: The body is longer than 1 MB. Only the first 1 MB is shown.

networkError.title: No response: {{reason}}
networkError.body: Check the URL and that the server is reachable from LoadAPI.

problems.targetNotAllowed: This host is in a private or internal network, so LoadAPI won't send requests to it.
problems.rateLimited: Too many requests. You can send up to 30 a minute, try again shortly.

sendRequest.bodyNotAllowed: {{method}} requests can't have a body. Clear the body to send.

requestAuth.noneHint: No auth is added to the request.

importSpec.title: Import an OpenAPI doc
importSpec.description: Paste an OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 document as YAML or JSON, or load it from a file. Its endpoints appear in the sidebar.
importSpec.name: Name (optional)
importSpec.contentPlaceholder:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: My API
  version: 1.0.0
paths: …

file.hint: Drop a .json, .yaml or .yml file here, or paste the document.
file.drop: Drop the file to load it

errors.tooLarge: {{name}} is over 5 MB, the import limit.
errors.unreadable: Couldn't read {{name}}. Try again or paste the document.

reimport.title: Re-import {{name}}
reimport.description: Paste or load the new version of this doc. Its endpoints are replaced; past runs stay in History.

errors.syntax: This isn't valid YAML or JSON.
errors.invalid: This isn't a valid OpenAPI document:
errors.unsupportedVersion: Only OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 are supported. Convert Swagger 2.0 docs first.
errors.notObject: The document must be an object with openapi, info and paths.
errors.missingPaths: The document needs a paths object.
errors.tooLarge: This doc is over 5 MB, the import limit.

endpointHeader.label: Endpoint
endpointHeader.relativeServer: This doc's server is a relative path ({{path}}). Enter the full URL to test against.

latency.summary: Latency chart. Latest second: p50 {{p50}} ms, p95 {{p95}} ms, p99 {{p99}} ms.

subtitles.errors: failed responses per second · % of all responses

throughput.summary: Throughput chart. Latest second: {{actual}} RPS against a target of {{target}}.

errorsChart.summary: Errors chart. Latest second: {{clientErrors}} 4xx, {{serverErrors}} 5xx, {{network}} network errors.

late.message_one: {{late}} request ({{share}}%) went out later than scheduled, so latency is understated. Try a lower target RPS.
late.message_other: {{late}} requests ({{share}}%) went out later than scheduled, so latency is understated. Try a lower target RPS.

runOutcome.noReason: The worker didn't give a reason.

activeRun.message: A test you started is still running. Only one test can run at a time.
